regime_context: Only three of fourteen Hong Kong themes are trend-eligible (Banks, High-Dividend Blue Chips, Industrials). The absolute-trend gate has historically cut drawdown (validated risk control), but cross-sectional momentum rank has no forward edge. Rotation is narrow, non-directional, with Banks the clear leader but a mean-revert hurst tag; the macro backdrop is dominated by unscheduled geopolitics and monetary announcements, raising caution.
emerging_watch: China Tech & Internet (3033.HK) is the only scorable theme with an ETF proxy; it is currently ineligible despite a marginal score above its durability bar, suggesting the trend filter is close. If it becomes eligible and holds a score >0.4 for 5 days, it could emerge as a growth challenger. Kill criterion: remains ineligible for 10 more days or score drops below 0.2.

theses.thesis: Banks is the top-ranked eligible theme, passing the absolute-trend gate which offers a validated drawdown-control edge in HK.
